pages.text: Creepers still sneak up on you. They still hiss. They still swell up.$(br2)Then they explode into $(l)confetti$().$(br2)No crater, no damage, just a party. Charged creepers throw twice as much. Be there when one goes off for the $(o)Surprise Party!$() advancement.
Miss the danger? Turn it off in $(l)config/harris-common.toml$() (set $(l)confettiCreepers = false$()), or from the Mods menu: Harris > Config.
